as_told.title: Weinstein speculates the Simons Foundation hides a secret physics program

plain: The mathematician Eric Weinstein says that if the US has a secret physics programme, perhaps on gravity and UFOs, it is probably Renaissance Technologies, an investment firm on Long Island founded by the mathematician Jim Simons, which he calls a black hole that hires exactly the specialists, such as differential geometers who study curved space, that such work would need. Michels relays more than once that Weinstein speculated this on Joe Rogan's podcast in 2024 and later tied it to the UFO legacy programme, while Weinstein repeats it in his own words on this show. If true, the hidden science behind recovered craft would sit inside a hedge fund.
